38923.title: SBR Summary and Expanded CSV exports carry the Location column at its designated slot
38923.custom_preconds:
Admin with the SBR view permission (reports project storage state)
The org has at least two accessible workplaces
ONE sales rep is credited on invoiced service WOs at BOTH workplaces, so the rep's summary row aggregates across locations and carries one invoice detail row per workplace (seeded via API)

custom_steps_separated.content: At the default single-location scope, download Summary (CSV)
Turn on All Locations, wait for the refetch, and download Summary (CSV) again
Download Expanded (CSV) in the same widened scope
Inspect the Expanded footer totals row

38920.title: PV Location column is scope-governed — hidden at one location, Multiple on a merged special-order row
38920.custom_preconds:
Owner/admin with PV access and at least two accessible workplaces
One inventory part sold on an invoiced WO at the active workplace (seeded via API)
The SAME vendor special-order part sold on invoiced WOs at BOTH workplaces, so PV merges them into one special-order row (seeded via API)

custom_steps_separated.content: Open PV at the default single-location scope
Turn on All Locations and wait for the server refetch
Set Type = Special Order and search the merged part number
Set Type = Inventory and search the seeded inventory part number
Open the Column Selection menu

38919.title: TU column selector hides Est. Lost Labor, persists across reload, and the export mirrors it
38919.custom_preconds:
Owner/admin logged in with TU access (reports project storage state)
A technician with a 3h WO clock and a 1h internal clock exists in the current calendar month (seeded via API), so the report is non-empty and Est. Lost Labor is non-zero
No saved TU view in this browser context, so the default five visible metric columns apply

custom_steps_separated.content: Open TU via the Reporting
Open the Column Selection menu
Toggle Est. Lost Labor OFF (and only that one column)
Reload the page
Download Summary (CSV) from the export menu
Re-open the selector and toggle Est. Lost Labor back ON

38922.title: WIP CSV export gains the Locations line while its column semantics stay exactly as shipped
38922.custom_preconds:
Owner/admin with WIP access (reports project storage state)
The org has at least two accessible workplaces
One approved WO with clocked time on a unique-VIN vehicle exists in the default (This Week) range, so it lands in the default "Approved - partially completed" tab (seeded via API)
The browser context carries NO saved WIP view, so Location starts default-hidden

custom_steps_separated.content: Open WIP from the Performance nav, isolate to the unique VIN via the asset filter, and download the CSV
Turn on All Locations, wait for the refetch, and download again
Toggle Location ON in the Column Selection menu and download again

38921.title: IV CSV export carries the As of and Locations metadata lines above the header, plus a scope-conditional Location column
38921.custom_preconds:
Owner/admin with IV access and at least two accessible workplaces
One in-stock, non-core, fixed-price part valued at the active workplace (seeded via API)

custom_steps_separated.content: Open the report at the default scope and search the seeded part number so the export is a single known row
Download the CSV from the export menu
Turn on All Locations, wait for the refetch, and download again
Inspect the data row's Location cell
